metadata.description: hack-vibe-x skills and hooks for Claude Code. Install only the plugins you want.

plugins.name: hack-user-skills-visual-decision
plugins.description: Questions Claude would ask in the terminal are asked in a local web page instead, with a visual for every option and the differences side by side. Answers are kept in .hus-visual-decision/decisions. Skill and hook for Claude Code.

plugins.name: hack-user-skills-criteria-gap
plugins.description: When you move on from Claude's answer without having read or understood it, a card above the prompt asks one question that makes you fill the gap: a point you skipped, a premise you missed or took differently. Answers are kept as text to look back on.

plugins.name: hack-user-skills-session-coach
plugins.description: Looks back on your AI work sessions: a daily diary written from yesterday's sessions, and a playbook of know-how pulled from sessions you pick. Skills for Claude Code and Codex.
